description: Boost your everyday productivity with the Acer Wired Keyboard, designed for professionals, students, and home users who demand comfort and reliability. Built with a full-size 104-key layout, it features soft-touch chiclet keys for accurate and quiet typing. The integrated palm rest ensures relaxed wrist support during long hours of work, while the durable key switches offer up to 10 million keystrokes, ensuring long life and consistent performance. The keyboard includes smart functionality such as a dedicated Co-Pilot shortcut key for instant AI access and a ₹ Rupee key for effortless financial typing—perfect for Indian users. With seamless USB 2.0 Plug & Play connectivity, you can simply connect and start typing without installing any drivers. Compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux, this keyboard is a reliable companion for desktops, laptops, all-in-one PCs, offices, and online learning setups. Whether you're drafting documents, managing spreadsheets, or working on day-to-day operations, the Acer Wired Keyboard delivers stable performance, comfort, and long-lasting durability, making it your ideal everyday work partner.
